papers.title: GraphForge: Training Working Agents with Graph-Anchored Workspace Synthesis
papers.summary: Presents an evidence-graph framework that synthesizes agent training tasks from real workspace files, deriving both the task statement and verification rubrics from the graph so each criterion is anchored to files. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-27B on 2,169 trajectories improves GDPVal by 65.7 points and SpreadsheetBench II by 13.7, and rubric-based rejection fine-tuning yields further gains.

papers.title: The Landscape of Agentic Reinforcement Learning for LLMs: A Survey
papers.summary: Survey of over 500 works that frames agentic RL as temporally extended POMDPs, in contrast to the single-step MDPs of conventional LLM-RL. It organizes the field by agentic capabilities (planning, tool use, memory, reasoning, self-improvement, perception) and application domains, and compiles open-source environments, benchmarks, and frameworks.
